# Rand <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Randomization](Language-Features-Randomization)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Rand:Int32 from:Int32, to:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | In | Int32 | required | Lowest result, or the highest when `to` is left out. |
| `to` | In | Int32 | `1` | Highest result. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** A random integer in the range.

## Description

Returns a random whole number from `from` to `to`, both included. With one argument the range is 1 up to that number. The same seed (see [SeedRnd](SeedRnd)) always gives the same sequence.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SeedRnd 1234
dice = Rand(1, 6)
Print dice >= 1 And dice <= 6
Print Rand(5, 5)
```

```text
1
5
```
